title: Kedi
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman notes that this name is mentioned in several places in the Talmud: in Yoma 44a and 72b and Menachot 55b, “Rav Ada bar Ahavah sat — and some say Kedi”; in Megillah 2b, Yevamot 90a, Nazir 2a and Chullin 73a, 81a and 118a, “Rava said — and some say Kedi”; in Menachot 8a, “Rabbi said — and some say R-Y-B-L — and some say Kedi”; and so it is in Berakhot 30a according to Dikdukei Soferim; and in Bava Metzia 2a, “R-P said — and some say Rav Shimi bar Ashi — and some say Kedi.” Hyman states that in all these places Rashi explained nothing, but in Gittin 85b, Rashi s.v. Ulorkheih, he explained that Kedi is a sage’s name. Hyman cites the Maharshal on Bava Metzia 4a for the view that Kedi is not a sage’s name but is like bekhedi, “for nothing” — that is, without the name of the speaker. He finds the same explanation in Halikhot Olam and takes it to be the view of our master Sherira Gaon in his Epistle, part 2, chapter 4, in the edition designated ב״ג תר״ה.

The earlier notes record the state of the evidence at the time. The cited edition of Sherira’s Epistle can now be identified as Ber Goldberg’s Ḥofes Maṭmonim (Berlin, 1845). On folio לב, the text says the formula is used when all the rabbis say the same thing, in a passage with an attribution that wavers between Rav and Shmuel. Halikhot Olam, by contrast, explains the formula as a statement reported without a named speaker. Rashi on Gittin 85b calls Kedi a sage’s name here. The consulted Chokhmat Shlomo gives both readings on Bava Metzia 2a. Hyman’s 4a locator is retained.

The consulted texts of Yoma 44a and 72b and Menachot 55b have Rav Ada bar Ahavah raising an objection where Hyman has him sitting. The longer formula occurs in Rashba’s quotation of Berakhot 30a, while the consulted Talmud text there ends the attribution after R’ Yehoshua ben Levi. Hyman’s citation of Dikdukei Soferim remains as reported. The cited formula was not located in the consulted text of Menachot 8a.
